privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.metaDescription: How {siteName} handles analytics, uploads, and local processing.
privacyPage.intro: {siteName} ("we") provides free online tools. This page explains what data may be collected and how uploads are handled.
privacyPage.pLocal: Many utilities (JSON, Base64, UUID, timestamps, JWT decode, time zones, date math, image compression) run entirely in your browser. That processing does not leave your device unless you explicitly download a file.
privacyPage.pPdf: When you merge PDFs, files are sent to our server only for the duration of the request. We do not use your documents for training or marketing. Temporary data should be discarded immediately after the response is sent—avoid uploading sensitive documents if your threat model requires zero server transit.
privacyPage.pAnalytics: Google Analytics 4 loads only if you choose “Accept all” on the cookie banner. You can switch to essential-only mode at any time by clearing site data for this domain in your browser.
privacyPage.pConsent: The first time you visit, you can accept optional analytics and advertising cookies, or choose essential-only mode. Essential-only mode does not load Google Analytics or third-party ad scripts until you clear the choice and accept again.
privacyPage.pAdvertising: Programs such as Google AdSense may be enabled later. Ad tags load only after you accept all cookies. Ad partners have their own privacy policies; you can use industry opt-out tools where available.
privacyPage.pOperator: {siteName} is operated by an individual. There is no registered company behind this project.
privacyPage.pContact: For privacy requests, questions about this policy, or advertising on this site, email:
